Synthetic population. None of the individuals shown exists, and none corresponds to a real person. The point on the map is random within the census section: the data resolution stops there, and the exact address is not in the file. Aggregate statistics reproduce the census within sampling noise, but only on the cross-tabulations the census constrains: where it does not, the panel says so.

The «tier» in the header concerns only the country of citizenship and the area of origin, and says whether a municipal source exists that distributes them below the municipal level. It does not measure the quality of the population: sex, age, marital status, education, employment status and citizenship are constrained by the census in every municipality, tier 0 included. The AVQ variables — health, trust, environment — carry no geographic information in any municipality.
